doc: Monster script b11a_moon for the Moon (kind 622, model b15a1), placed with the Dark Element in the timed boss fight on the d06b03 palace terrace. It is attached to map part p06_d06b03-0 and has no map or body collision and no lock-on. It slowly closes in on the arena, moving toward the point 5000 units from the origin along its own direction, and when the 5 minute stopwatch runs out it stops and runs map program 1201, the game over.
